channel.title: Pier & Point · LUMA Hotel San Francisco
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for LUMA Hotel San Francisco (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: The Sky Lounge debut in the fall is a plan reported by…
item.description: The Sky Lounge debut in the fall is a plan reported by Potrero View in September 2022; the hotel's own June 28, 2022 release had said it was set to open later that summer, and no source says when it opened. The hotel's release names Cole Martinez Curtis & Associates as designer without saying which part of the design. Source: https://www.hotel-online.com/news/luma-hotel-san-francisco-opens-in-san-francisco-californias-mission-bay-neighborhood/.

item.title: Correction · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: Cavaña's tenant listing now also cites LUMA Hotel's live…
item.description: Cavaña's tenant listing now also cites LUMA Hotel's live dining page, read October 6, 2026; its earlier source was a February 2023 review. Twyne's location now reads first-floor community space, as LUMA's own page says, rather than lobby. Source: https://www.lumahotels.com/san-francisco/dine/; https://www.lumahotels.com/san-francisco/dine/twyne/.

item.title: Correction · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: LUMA is no longer described as a 22-story hotel (its…
item.description: LUMA is no longer described as a 22-story hotel (its rooftop bar is on the 17th floor, and 2018 coverage gave 16 or 17 stories), and its developer is now named as SOMA Hotel, a Stanford Hotel affiliate, per Hoodline. The Cavaña opening is now late January 2023 from a post-opening review, replacing the February 2 date taken from an announcement. The 2018 groundbreaking and 2022 opening milestones link the articles instead of bare domains, and the Trevino Wine Bar entry no longer says it is in the lobby. Source: Hoodline, 2018-03 (https://hoodline.com/2018/03/marriott-soma-mission-bay-hotel-breaks-ground/); San Francisco Chronicle (https://www.sfchronicle.com/bayarea/article/Groundbreaking-for-SF-hotel-marks-milestone-for-12795570.php); Hospitality Net, 2022-07-04 (https://www.hospitalitynet.org/announcement/41008223/luma-hotel-san-francisco-opens-in-san-francisco-californias-mission-bay-neighborhood); Potrero View, 2022-09 (https://www.potreroview.net/luma-becomes-mission-bays-first-hotel/); The Perfect Spot SF, 2023-02-24 (https://theperfectspotsf.com/2023/02/24/latin-vibes-tunes-cocktails-food-with-stunning-sf-views-at-new-rooftop-bar-cavana/); LUMA Hotel San Francisco, Dine (https://www.lumahotels.com/san-francisco/dine/).

item.title: Added · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: Cavaña, a Latin American rooftop cocktail bar on LUMA Hotel's…
item.description: Cavaña, a Latin American rooftop cocktail bar on LUMA Hotel's 17th floor, opened in late January 2023 according to a review published February 24, 2023 (The Perfect Spot). What Now's February 1, 2023 article announced a February 2 opening, but it was written before the event, so that date is not used. Source: https://theperfectspotsf.com/2023/02/24/latin-vibes-tunes-cocktails-food-with-stunning-sf-views-at-new-rooftop-bar-cavana/.

item.title: Milestone · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: Potrero View (September 2022) reports the… (Sep 2022)
item.description: Potrero View (September 2022) reports the 17th-floor Sky Lounge rooftop bar planned to debut in the fall (a planned, not an actual, date); the hotel's June 28, 2022 opening release had said the lounge was 'set to open later this summer'; no source read says when or whether it opened (Sep 2022). Source: Potrero View, 2022-09; Hotel Online (LUMA press release datelined June 28, 2022), 2022-06-28.
item.source: Potrero View, 2022-09; Hotel Online (LUMA press release datelined June 28, 2022), 2022-06-28

item.description: LUMA Hotel opens at 100 Channel Street, Mission Bay's first hotel (Jun 2022). Source: Potrero View, 2022-09.

item.description: LUMA Hotel San Francisco (100 Channel St) opens, Mission Bay's first hotel (Potrero View: 'In June, LUMA Hotel opened'; Hospitality Net's opening release is dated July 4, 2022) (~Jun 2022). item.title: Under construction · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: Groundbreaking ceremony with Mayor… (Mar 29, 2018)
item.description: Groundbreaking ceremony with Mayor Mark Farrell for the hotel, then called Marriott SoMa Mission Bay, scheduled to open in 2020 (Mar 29, 2018). Source: San Francisco Chronicle, 2018-03-31; Hoodline, 2018-03.

item.title: Under construction · LUMA Hotel San Francisco: Groundbreaking for the hotel then… (Mar 29, 2018)
item.description: Groundbreaking for the hotel then billed as 'Marriott SOMA Mission Bay' at 100 Channel St (became LUMA Hotel San Francisco), Mission Bay's first hotel project; Potrero View later wrote that the Marriott chain was never part of actual plans (Mar 29, 2018). Source: https://hoodline.com/2018/03/marriott-soma-mission-bay-hotel-breaks-ground/; https://www.sfchronicle.com/bayarea/article/Groundbreaking-for-SF-hotel-marks-milestone-for-12795570.php; https://www.potreroview.net/luma-becomes-mission-bays-first-hotel/.
